name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Govt of India
short_description: End-to-end holistic support for traditional artisans with skill training, Rs. 15,000 toolkit incentive, and collateral-free loans up to Rs. 3 Lakh at 5% interest.
detailed_description: PM Vishwakarma is designed to uplift traditional artisans and craftspeople across 18 designated trades (such as carpenters, blacksmiths, goldsmiths, potters, cobblers, tailors) with official recognition, stipend of Rs. 500/day during skill training, Rs. 15,000 modern toolkit grant, and collateral-free enterprise credit up to Rs. 3,00,000.
description_kannada: 18 ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಕಸುಬುದಾರರು ಮತ್ತು ಕುಶಲಕರ್ಮಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಕೌಶಲ್ಯ ತರಬೇತಿ, ರೂ. 15,000 ಟೂಲ್‌ಕಿಟ್ ಅನುದಾನ ಮತ್ತು ಶೇ. 5ರ ರಿಯಾಯಿತಿ ಬಡ್ಡಿದರದಲ್ಲಿ ರೂ. 3 ಲಕ್ಷದವರೆಗೆ ಆಸ್ತಿರಹಿತ ಸಾಲ ನೀಡುವ ಯೋಜನೆ.

rules.name: Traditional Artisan / Craftsman
rules.source_citation: PM Vishwakarma Scheme Guidelines 2023, Section 3.1 (Eligible Trades)
rules.clarification_question_en: Are you engaged in one of the 18 traditional artisan trades (carpenter, potter, tailor, cobbler, blacksmith, etc.)?
rules.clarification_question_kn: ನೀವು 18 ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಕಸುಬುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ (ಬಡಗಿ, ಕುಂಬಾರ, ಕಮ್ಮಾರ, ದರ್ಜಿ, ಅಕ್ಕಸಾಲಿಗ ಇತ್ಯಾದಿ) ತೊಡಗಿಸಿಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದೀರಾ?

rules.name: Minimum Age 18
rules.clarification_question_en: What is your current age in years?

benefits_summary: PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID, Rs. 500/day training stipend, Rs. 15,000 toolkit voucher, and collateral-free credit up to Rs. 3 Lakh at 5% interest.
benefits_amount: Rs. 15,000 toolkit + Loan up to Rs. 3 Lakh
required_documents: Active mobile number linked to Aadhaar
application_process: Visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with Aadhaar and mobile.
Biometric authentication and verification of trade details.
Gram Panchayat or ULB verification followed by District Committee approval.
Download PM Vishwakarma digital ID and attend basic skill training.
source_title: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Govt of India
source_excerpt: To strengthen and nurture traditional artisans and craftspeople, who work with their hands and tools.
